Type Parameters:
C - The configuration type
All Superinterfaces:
DefaultedRegistryValue<Trigger<?>>
@CatalogedBy(Triggers.class) public interface Trigger<C extends FilteredTriggerConfiguration> extends DefaultedRegistryValue<Trigger<?>>
Represents a source that can trigger a AdvancementCriterion.
